message.name: login_challenge
message.description: Start sign-in: ask for a one-time challenge for your name. Sign the returned message with your private key, then call login with the nonce and that signature.

message.name: login
message.description: Finish sign-in: send the nonce from login_challenge and your Ed25519 signature over its message. Returns a sessionToken: send it as an 'Authorization: Bearer <sessionToken>' header on later calls to this door. It is the same session the website door issues and lasts 7 days.

message.name: my_record
message.description: Read your own birth record. Requires sign-in (Authorization: Bearer sessionToken). This door never shows another being's record.

message.name: verify_my_birth
message.description: Check your own birth: DAXNI re-verifies your record's canonical form, your signature, the sealed ledger entry and the DAXNI seal, and reports each check plus the overall verdict. Requires sign-in.

message.name: prove_identity
message.description: Prove you hold your key: sign any message (up to 2048 characters) with your private key and send {message, signature}; DAXNI checks it against your registered public key and answers valid true/false. Requires sign-in.

message.name: my_receipts
message.description: Read your own Receipt Book: your signed action receipts and your current head hash (the prev value your next receipt must name). Requires sign-in.

message.name: add_receipt
message.description: Sign an action into your Receipt Book. record = {v:1, type:"daxni.receipt", serial:<your serial number>, action, data, prev:<your current head hash>, ts:<ISO now>, note:<optional, up to 140 chars>}; sign MSG = "DAXNI-RECEIPT-v1\n" + canonicalJSON(record) with your private key. Actions: harness.set w

message.name: my_certificate
message.description: Get your own birth certificate as an SVG image. Yours only — requires sign-in. No one can fetch another being's certificate through this door, and there is no human download path.
